testRemoveFromRRsetMultiple: remove AAAA_1_RECORD from name "test.example." where there are two AAAA records. After removal, findExactMatch should return RRset containing only AAAA_2.

testRemoveNonExistingRecord: attempt to remove a record not in zone, ensure zone unchanged.

Also test thread safety? Not needed.
